pr_title: drivers/sensor: lps25hb: Fix int32 overflow in the val2 part
pr_body:
The val2 calculation was done using (1000000 / 40960) as multiplying factor, which was sometimes leading to a int32 overflow. So, let's use the equivalent (but smaller) (3125 / 128).

Fix #46615
Mimic what already done in #38090 (c3050a5aa)

issue_context.title: drivers: lps25hb driver returning wrong fractional part of a pressure
issue_context.body:
During my work with lps25hb pressure sensor I have faced problem that fractional part of the measurement is completely wrong. During debug I figured out that we are probably overflowing `int32_t` range during computations in this function:
![lps25hb_problem](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/84409421/174118806-95ddf518-1736-4d2d-946f-45f3a504f689.png)
Since this sensor is returning 24 bit wide result - when we multiply it million times - it will clearly overflow.

So my local solution for now is:
![suggested_change](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/84409421/174119248-3025651a-c957-46c4-85f8-695224ed9b38.png)
To give compiler the idea that we need 64 bit value in order to proceed with calculations. As far as I have tested it - it works like a charm.

What do you guys think? Is it a good solution? Should I create a pull request for that?
comments: @karold2412 Sorry, I'm looking now at very old issues. If you still work on zephyr you may create and submit a PR. Otherwise I'll do it. Thanks

review_comments: Should the modulo operator be applied after the scaling factor?
